# Ashish Singh

> Portfolio of Ashish Singh, a UCLA Statistics and Data Science student (M.S. expected Dec 2026) pursuing roles in Data Science, AI Engineering, ML Engineering, and analytics.

Ashish Singh is a data scientist in training who combines Python, R, SQL, and Tableau with statistical modeling to answer practical questions from complex data. He holds a B.S. in Statistics and Data Science from UCLA (2024) and is completing an M.S. in Applied Statistics and Data Science at UCLA (expected Dec 2026). His work spans alumni data operations and reporting, LLM evaluation, remote-sensing analysis, and machine learning for actuarial, healthcare, and prediction-market applications.

## Project details

- [Predicting Heart Failure](https://aashishssingh.github.io/ashish-singh-portfolio.github.io/heart-failure.html): Actuarial mortality modeling with Logistic Regression, SGD SVM, and Random Forest.
- [The 99-Cent Question: Kalshi Prediction Markets](https://aashishssingh.github.io/ashish-singh-portfolio.github.io/kalshi-prediction-markets.html): STATS 414 team project testing whether Kalshi favorites priced at 90 to 99 cents win as often as their price implies, with random forest and XGBoost models.
- [Civic Engagement Survey Analysis](https://aashishssingh.github.io/ashish-singh-portfolio.github.io/civic-engagement.html): Survey analytics with Python, pandas, NLTK, and sentiment analysis.
